articles.title: Mike Yastrzemski’s home run for Braves sends Red Sox to postseason
articles.description: The Red Sox are postseason bound for the second year in a row, thanks to a home run by the grandson of a franchise legend

articles.title: First-inning implosion costs Red Sox chance to punch own postseason ticket
articles.description: After falling to the Tampa Bay Rays on Sunday afternoon, the Boston Red Sox will wait to see if the Atlanta Braves can punch their postseason ticket for them by defeating the Houston Astros

articles.title: Red Sox mailbag: Should Garrett Crochet, Tanner Houck be on playoff roster?
articles.description: Even if they can make it back, should the Red Sox add Garrett Crochet and Tanner Houck to their playoff roster after such long absences? Those and more reader questions answered in this week’s mailbag.

articles.title: How Red Sox’ Tanner Houck fared in final game of rehab assignment
articles.description: Saturday’s Triple-A Worcester Red Sox loss included a solid performance by Tanner Houck in his final rehab game

articles.title: Red Sox waste dazzling performance by Brayan Bello, get walked off by Rays
articles.description: Red Sox waste Brayan Bello’s best start of the year, get walked off by Rays

articles.title: Red Sox get promising Willson Contreras injury update as postseason nears

articles.title: Roman Anthony’s big game puts Red Sox on precipice of clinching playoff bid
articles.description: With their win over the Rays, the Red Sox can now clinch a playoff berth as soon as Saturday night.

articles.title: Red Sox slugger out of lineup a day after getting hit by pitch on hand

articles.title: Trevor Story’s late home run helps Red Sox flip script on Rangers

articles.description: One of the Red Sox’s top hitters left the game on Thursday after being hit in the hand by a pitch.

articles.title: Red Sox held to three hits, drop series to Rangers with lifeless loss

articles.description: Herald writer Mac Cerullo brought his son to his first Red Sox game on Sunday, and while heavy rain threatened to put a damper on the day, the Baseball Gods came through in immaculate fashion.

articles.title: Patrick Sandoval allows four runs in second, Red Sox lose opener to Rangers
articles.description: Patrick Sandoval put the Red Sox in a four-run hole early, and the offense squandered a pair of bases loaded opportunities to drop Tuesday’s opener against the Rangers.

articles.title: Red Sox dealt significant blow as top reliever’s injury turns season-ending
articles.description: The Red Sox will almost certainly be without one of their top relievers for the remainder of the regular season and any potential postseason games.

articles.title: Garrett Whitlock has ‘best friend back’ with Tanner Houck nearing Red Sox return
articles.description: Garrett Whitlock discusses with the Herald his special bond with Tanner Houck, and the excitement of Houck nearing a return to the Red Sox roster after Tommy John surgery.
